title: Dance repertoire: waltzes, foxtrots and gallops
summary: He recalls the kinds of dances his band played and says the band died out.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Can you tell me anything more about the music? What kind of dancing they had in those days? Were they waltzes or two steps or foxtrot or quadrille or what kind of music was it?

Oh, waltzes, foxtrot, different things. And the gallops. Gallops. Oh, yeah. All such things is that. Some want this one. Some want to dance this one. Oh, they, they used to kick about the music. We played so nice, you know. And so, them boys, they died out. And so I gave them. And we'd bother with it no more. And that's been a long time. Never did bother with it no more. When did you take up the clarinet, Mr. Robinson? The clarinet? I just picked up on that myself. I could play it too, boy.
